scientific_integrity: Explicit finite acyclic discrete-Morse matching, exact integral attaching matrix with primitive row relation and a unit rank-three minor, and an independent full finite-field chain computation. The stated integral homotopy conclusion follows from CW attaching maps and their matrix. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified nineteen-vertex Paley tournament; no arbitrary Hadamard-design theorem.
No diagonal loops, weighted filtration, equivariant decomposition or general Paley-tournament family.
scientific_scope: Integral homotopy type of the simplicial complex generated by the nineteen irreflexive outward-neighborhood blocks of the quadratic-residue tournament modulo 19.
title: The mixed-dimensional out-neighborhood complex of the Paley tournament on nineteen vertices
